plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-10 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) History (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'History & History Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', History (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints Total Credits, B.S. Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the B.A. carries a 16-credit foreign-language requirement that the map expressly does not include. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15 in all eight semesters) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's History Curriculum totals 36 credits (Core 12, European History 3, Electives 21); the map places HIST 1100 for the European requirement (the catalog allows HIST 1100 or HIST 1110), HIST 2700 for the United States History requirement (the catalog allows HIST 2700 or HIST 2710), a Year 3 Fall underrepresented-communities course from the catalog's list (HIST 3000, 3620, 3630, 3700, 3880, 4600, 4760, 4780), five upper-division elective slots totaling the catalog's 15 upper-division elective credits, and one further major elective slot toward the 6 lower/upper-division elective credits. The catalog states all major courses must be passed with a C- or better and no more than 12 lower-division credits count toward the major. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
